usageNotes: Use this endpoint to audit subscription compliance across all remotes registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager — for example, before a maintenance window or when onboarding a new remote cluster. The `state` field in each result summarizes the remote as `active`, `mixed` (some nodes unsubscribed), `none`, or `unknown`; drill into per-node detail with `verbose=true` if you need to identify which specific nodes are out of compliance. Cached results are returned by default (up to 24 hours old); pass `max-age=0` to force a live fetch from all remotes.

examples.summary: Fetch live subscription status for all remotes with per-node detail

tips: The default max-age of 86400 seconds means you may see stale subscription state; use max-age=0 when accuracy matters (e.g. compliance checks or after adding a subscription key).
The `node-status` map is only populated when verbose=true and the caller has sufficient privileges on the remote; without it, only the aggregate `state` enum is returned.
A `state` of `unknown` typically means PDM could not reach the remote to check — verify remote connectivity before treating it as a subscription problem.
This endpoint requires no special privilege beyond `user: all`, so API tokens with minimal scope can poll it safely.
